summary: Short, steep parked kerb with flats 12-20 m away on both sides.

drivers.seclusion: Flats about 12-17 m beyond the kerb on the same side, more flats and houses 19-24 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along both kerbs; 16 m of kerb fits a van, with one car already parked at the south end.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street with local traffic only.
drivers.convention: Weekday 1P and 2P signs only; cars park here overnight, so a van blends in.

flags: Steep: about 7% mean grade, 14% max over a short step
Hill street: van may roll, use wedges
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the kerb from the east side; open to the west.
cannot_judge: Exact slope, as the DEM step is coarse

best_section.where: East kerb of Mitre Street, south of the Moorman Place flats
